verdict.summary: The change correctly moves all removals ahead of the single add-label request, so a failed transition can lose a dispatch-enabling label but cannot create the ready/deferred overlap caused by the former add-first order. The new live-label reread fails closed on missing additions, residual removals, and malformed API data. The self-test exercises both write order and intermediate states across the transition table, independently pins the deferred transition's required removals, covers silent-success failures on both DELETE and POST, and confirms the healthy and unreadable reread paths. I found no diff-scoped correctness, security, or test-validity issue requiring changes.
